discussion.body: Temple of Earth. Seat: Constium highlands, near Iron's Gate sightline. World aspect: stone, rail bed, mountain roots, the right of a floor to stay a floor. Constium industry is a parasite on this aspect and pretends to be its priest. Sigil: Keystone. Combat: defense, quake, line-hold. Civic: rails run, mines hold, Cannon carriage does not list. Failure: works slump, rail breaks, Cannon aim drifts off Fire and can score a living city. That is why Brann's book matters even if Brann is dead. Relation: Earth pins Fire's door; if Earth fails, Fissure geometry moves. Owner NPC: Earth speaker under Vortan's budget. Party link: Brann.
